notes.title: Gameplay Insights
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We see that you are intrigued by the main gameplay of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095340/Road_96_Mile_0/]Road 96: Mile 0[/url]. So, we will be happy to shed some light on this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/69352e054e5fe7ac93fb6687ce2599cb34969a11.gif[/img]

[h3]Main Gameplay[/h3]
We know that many of you are worried that the Road 96 gameplay that you loved so much will be different in the prequel – Road 96: Mile 0. We have relieving news for you, Road 96: Mile 0 is still a [b]narrative adventure[/b] and the main gameplay is very similar to the one in Road 96. 

You will be able to discover the locations of White Sands with a first-person view, enjoy minigames, have dialogues and make choices that will determine the final ending in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/aefb260566bf7c814317d696a43218f5b14621ea.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Mechanics[/h3]
A new feature in the gameplay is “Musical rides” – the skating journey that will allow you to better understand and feel the story of the characters and the world of Petria through a combination of visuals and music. It is not the main gameplay part, but it is still an important part of immersion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/89a63907bd539458e2d7cf54968d4cfc7031ba90.gif[/img]

The music is a vital part for all of us working on the game, so we do our best to choose the most fitting and touching sounds for you to truly experience and enjoy the game as much as possible! We hope that you will like the combination of the old and new mechanics ❤️

[h2]Wishlist now![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095340/Road_96_Mile_0/

notes.title: It's Midweek Madnes on the Road 96!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/ce699c4ed2320eb1aeb1900bf666b5bd347c01bc.jpg[/img]
[h3]Hello Hitchhikers!
What a beautiful day to once again hit the road, right? [/h3]
 
Sun is shining, your backpack is ready, and you’ve got the comfiest shoes already on your feet – so what are you waiting for, huh?

Do you need any other reason to visit Petria? What about [i][b]new points shop items[/b][/i] that we’ve got for you (and to be honest, we are dying to see your works with all these crazy pieces).
Also, we’ve got a [i][b]bunch of sales[/b][/i] waiting for you and all your friends that are waiting to dive deep into the Road 96 world!

Be sure to check them out:
30% off on the [b]game[/b] – for you and tour adventurous friends
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466640/Road_96/
25% off on the [b]On the Road 96 Documentary[/b] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1786220/On_the_Road_96__Documentary/
50% off on the Soundtrack that also got awarded with Pegase Award
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1616120/Road_96__Soundtrack/
and 50% off on the [b]Prologue eBook[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681090/Road_96_Prologue_eBook/

 
As you can see, we’ve got a lot of stuff waiting for you, and now you know why we call it [b]MIDWEEK MADNESS[/b] 😉
 
[i]See you on the road![/i]


Psssst!
To find the new items we've got for you: go to the points shop and "filter by game: Road 96" in the AVATAR and BACKGROUND section ;)

notes.title: Today is the special day for fans in Poland!
notes.content:
[h3]Road 96 gets a Polish localization (subtitles) with the newest update as the best pre-Christmas gift ever![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/3724f304ce1dd534cc5dc0574c6e7a35d8b8644e.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that the procedural road-trip adventure Road 96 is getting a [b]Polish localization (subtitles)[/b] today! 
The local team at Koch Media Poland has been getting a lot of questions and requests to translate the game from fans on social media, which were especially ignited in recent weeks/days by [b]the great review scores[/b] that Road 96 was receiving in the media all around the world. 

All of the eager gamers can fully enjoy the title in their native tongue.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
And if you are still wondering if you should pack your backpack and try your luck on Road 96 –hesitate no more and get it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466640/

notes.title: Patch 1.03 has been released!
notes.content:
4 major bugs have been fixed:

- Players that were experiencing video problems should now have videos played correctly and therefore be able to progress throughout the game
- The player should now spawn at the correct position in the scene "Let's get serious" after the meeting
- The scene "Short circuit" was not loading properly for some players and should now be displayed correctly
- Some players were still getting stuck in the scene "Nobody's supposed to be here" they should not be anymore

Enjoy :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/253df163cc54f7795111621f0f13f555694abfb6.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.02 has been released!
notes.content:
5 major bugs have been fixed:

- The player should no longer get stuck in the scene "Blame it on the rain" when discussing with John.
- The AirHockey's puck should no longer disappear in the scene "Let's get serious"
- The player should no longer be stuck during the offshore exam.
- The Taxis's ticket can now be scratched and the player should no longer be stuck when inspecting it.
- The player should no longer be locked in the secret room in the scene  "Let's get serious"

Enjoy :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/253df163cc54f7795111621f0f13f555694abfb6.png[/img]
